title: kb_http.py's internal-error line prints the exception text, which can hold request content
goal: answer in kb_http.py writes the exception class and no exception message to stderr when kb_mcp.handle raises, so a request's content (a question, a path, a name) never reaches a host journal; a test raises an error carrying a marker text and asserts the marker is absent from stderr
